accepted_adaptations: RL-ViGen patch set P1-P20 from setup/apply_patches.py
SVEA Places365 loader is configured to select validation directly and reject directory fallback
Native runner accepts conventional tar member prefixes and captures calibration CPU/GPU resource telemetry
Preflight manifests declare zero frames and omit training-only resource claims
Native runner emits explicit completion and result-archive failure diagnostics
Result archive membership is verified with Python tarfile, not tar listing text
Places365 validation asset is an explicit SVEA-only remote input
Calibration bootstrap provisions GNU time before invoking /usr/bin/time
RL-ViGen launcher selects PYTHON_BIN, PYTHON, or remote python3; it never assumes the developer virtualenv
ALDA, IDAAC, and PPG launchers select PYTHON_BIN, PYTHON, or remote python3; they never assume the developer virtualenv
Resource sampler records per-GPU utilization and memory alongside per-process VRAM
Native dependency input pins termcolor because RL-ViGen logger imports it without declaring it upstream

Offline W&B shim permits the disabled import path and opens no socket; tracking calls are RECORDED to a local jsonl sink rather than refused, because ctrl calls wandb.init unconditionally and because metrics some baselines log nowhere else are read back from that sink. RLGEN_WANDB_STRICT=1 restores the original fail-closed behaviour
Native runner import-gates RL-ViGen train before timed calibration
Native runner import-gates the selected RobosuiteVGB wrapper before timed calibration
Source-hashed Robosuite import-closure manifest exact-pins exceptional imports before wrapper import and timed calibration
Native train import is locally verified under the exact offline remote path precedence
Native dependency input exact-pins every direct Robosuite requirement because editable Robosuite is installed with --no-deps; successful manifests retain resolved package versions
Native dependency input pins matplotlib because robosuiteVGB imports it unconditionally while declaring no package dependencies; failure bt15uqu1idas8dkq38vf supplied the raw evidence
P15 adds an exact terminal evaluation/completion marker and snapshot after finite training; it is ENABLES-class protocol behavior, not an added learning update
P16 makes terminal snapshot retention fail closed: the runner copies the exact output only after the final marker and exits non-zero if the checkpoint is absent or empty
Resource sampler normalizes a macOS ps comma decimal only for host-side telemetry parsing; the behavior has a focused characterization test
No unreviewed Gemini requirements or adapter changes accepted
ctrl, ibac_sni and dmc_gb launchers select PYTHON_BIN, PYTHON, or remote python3; the interpreter closure now covers every launcher, not the three previously audited
Native runner executes a list of (baseline, seed) cells rather than one baseline: each cell has its own pinned hydra run directory, output directory, resource samples, terminal snapshot and curve
Native runner returns each cell's train.csv, eval.csv and TensorBoard event directory, and fails closed when a cell produced no training curve
Native runner records the container disk budget for /tmp and / in environment.json, because a long run writes one replay episode per 500 frames
CELL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS caps each cell inside GNU time, so one hung cell fails alone instead of destroying the finished cells' evidence before the archive is written
NATIVE_CONCURRENT=1 starts every cell of a job at once; it is the packing measurement and later the production shape
NATIVE_EXTRA_OVERRIDES is a recorded hydra-override escape hatch for local rehearsal; it appears verbatim in the run manifest so such a run is never silently pooled

P17 deletes an always-raising analytic-entropy log line from algos/drq.py; drq's entropy signal is -actor_logprob and deliberately keeps its own name rather than being unified with drqv2's analytic actor_ent
families.json + family.py resolve each cell's argv, artifact set and overlay-asset need from data, so the runner carries no per-family branch; metrics are deliberately NOT unified across families
Payload allowlist is base plus per-family payload_members, and the declaration travels inside the archive so the remote verifier applies the same rule; a dmc_gb job cannot contain another clone

dmc_gb finalize_run adds a terminal evaluation, terminal checkpoint and the exact marker after its unchanged loop; its save_freq default of 100k would otherwise leave a 10k or 100k run with no checkpoint at all
dmc_gb and ALDA's vendored copy of utils.write_info no longer treat `git describe` as a precondition for training; the payload is a tarball, so no DataSphere job is a git checkout
Places365 val pinning is applied to dmc_gb's src/augmentations.py as well as RL-ViGen's utils.py, because soda overlays from the same dataset and the two would otherwise draw from different splits
requirements-native.txt pins kornia, einops, xmltodict and tqdm, declared by dmcontrol-generalization-benchmark's own setup/conda.yaml and installed by nothing here
summarize_result.py derives the per-cell throughput and resource envelope from a returned archive rather than from a hand-read log

P18 writes a step-stamped copy of each intermediate snapshot when RLVIGEN_PRESERVE_SNAPSHOTS is set; upstream saves ten times in a 500k run and keeps one, and the nine it overwrites are a budget curve
P20 records the realized post-reset Door pose and bounded episode diagnostics at the common VGBWrapper boundary; the action path is unchanged
idaac finalize_run adds one held-out evaluation and the exact executed-frame marker after its unchanged loop; upstream evaluates only when j % log_interval == 0 and two episodes have finished
ppg train_fn exposes seed and log_dir on the command line; get_robosuite_venv already took a seed that train_fn never passed, so every PPG run was seed 0 with an unseeded network
ctrl train_ppo writes a terminal msgpack of its TrainState; upstream's own checkpoint import is commented out and checkpoint_interval is never read, so its own evaluate_ppo.py had nothing to load
ppg_cell.sh, ibac_sni_cell.sh and ctrl_cell.sh compose train-then-evaluate-then-marker for the three families whose training entry point does not evaluate; zero lines change in any clone
The ALDA launcher exposes only third_party/alda/models, because third_party/alda/trainers is a regular package and shadowed ALDA's own namespace package regardless of path order

Per-family dependency installs, import gates and failures are isolated to their own family; ctrl is co_schedulable false because jax[cuda12] replaces numpy and cudnn with versions torch, numba and matplotlib reject
A cell's retained checkpoint is gated on containing finite floating-point values, per docs/CONSTRUCTION.md#c57
RUNNER_CONTRACT is stamped into the payload manifest and checked immediately after extraction, because the runner and the payload are separate job inputs and drifted once
